instrument: train on years <= X, evaluate ONLY held-out year X+1; champion recipe, adopted balanced risk config; meta and money channels rebuilt per net
reading: This is the honest analogue of what the system does on unseen data, and it is a different animal from the research table: 4 of 7 held-out years are NEGATIVE, the median year is roughly flat, and the mean is carried entirely by 2021 (+113%). The research-year record (all years positive) is a product of training and selection on those years. It also explains sealed 2026's +1.8%: a roughly flat median is exactly what this profile predicts. THE BASELINE TO BEAT IS NOW THIS COLUMN, and the operator's target is a median >= +30%.
caveats: one seed per cutoff - seed variance is known to be large (P18 spread 0.14)
early cutoffs train on very little history (2019 net saw 6 symbols)
the sleeve (system 07) is not included here - trend book only

fear_veto_25.reading: Paired on identical nets. Gains concentrated in the ACTIVE years (2019, 2021); exactly zero where the book barely trades (2022-2025, exposure 1-4%).
